alvo.titulo: What are they doing right now?
alvo.foco: falar do agora com right now e at the moment (sweater, moment, journal, shack, snack, monster)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende marcas do presente: I am making a sweater right now. I am busy at the moment. Are you reading the journal?
falas: Mabel, what are you doing right now?
I am making a sweater right now.
I am busy at the moment.

alvo.foco: usar um hotel com check in e check out (receptionist, bellboy, single room, double room, key, suitcase)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a usar um hotel: check in (fazer a entrada) e check out (fazer a saída).
falas: Hello. I want to check in.
Welcome. Do you have a reservation?
Yes. A single room for two nights.

alvo.foco: contar o passado com saw e ate (ghost, cherry, dots, apple, strawberry, maze)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende mais dois passados irregulares: I saw a ghost in the maze. I ate the cherry. Yum! We ate dots in the maze.
falas: I saw a ghost in the maze.
Boo! I saw a cherry.
I ate the cherry. Yum!

alvo.foco: contar o passado com swam e came (reef, turtle, mask, shark, boat, tropical fish)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende dois passados irregulares: swam (nadou) e came (veio).
alvo.obra_atual: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas
falas: How was the dive? Did you swim at the reef?
Yes! I swam with a mask.
What did you see?

alvo.gramatica: easy as pie · a piece of cake
alvo.foco: aprender expressões com easy as pie e a piece of cake (pie, cake, easy, test, win, quick)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende duas expressões para algo muito fácil: It’s as easy as pie, Dad. And a cake? That is a piece of cake. The recipe is easy and quick.
falas: Tina, bake a pie for the shop.
It’s as easy as pie, Dad.
And a cake? That is a piece of cake.

alvo.gramatica: reach the top · enjoy the view
alvo.foco: subir a montanha com reach the top e enjoy the view (top, view, snack, sunset, boots, rest)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a falar de uma subida: reach the top (chegar ao topo) e enjoy the view (curtir a vista).
falas: We walk slowly in the mountains.
My boots hurt. Can we take a rest?
Yes. Eat a snack and drink water.

alvo.foco: descrever sentimentos com feel + adjetivo (better, sick, angry, lonely, calm, doctor)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a descrever como se sente: I feel better, thanks. The patient feels sick. He feels angry too.
falas: Doctor Carter, how do you feel?
I feel better, thanks.
The patient feels sick.

alvo.gramatica: watch the parade · see the fireworks
alvo.foco: falar do festival com watch the parade e see the fireworks (parade, fireworks, music, crowd, balloons, ferris wheel)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende verbos de ver: watch the parade (assistir ao desfile) e see the fireworks (ver os fogos).
falas: Dad, the summer festival is here!
Yes! Let us watch the parade.
I hear the music. The crowd is huge!

alvo.gramatica: Could you say that again? · One more time
alvo.foco: pedir de novo com Could you say that again? e One more time (phrase, word, time, loud, repeat, speaker)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende um jeito educado de pedir repetição: Could you say that again? e One more time, please.
falas: Today we learn a new phrase.
Sorry, I did not hear. Could you say that again?
Of course. “Break the ice.”

alvo.foco: fechar acordos com It’s a deal e Deal! (deal, price, offer, swap, agree, money)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a fechar um acordo: It’s a deal! e Deal! (combinado!).
falas: Hi! What is the price of this card?
Five dollars. It is rare.
I make an offer: three dollars.

alvo.foco: entender mais formas faladas com kinda, sorta e gimme (kinda, sorta, gimme, bit, word, cold)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende mais formas faladas: It’s kinda cold today, Zack. It’s sorta fun. Gimme the ball, please.
falas: It’s kinda cold today, Zack.
It’s sorta fun.
Gimme the ball, please.

alvo.foco: se despedir com carinho com Take care e Until next time (care, safe, hug, time, tea, wave)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende uma despedida carinhosa: Take care, Daffy. Stay safe, Bugs. Give me a hug.
falas: Take care, Daffy.
Stay safe, Bugs.
Give me a hug.
